name: Path-Reduction Label Hypergraph
definition: Let $A$ be corner-peelable ample and let $D=\{u,c,v\}\subseteq A$ induce the path $u-c-v$. For an acyclic USO $\mathcal O$ of $A$, let $S_{\mathcal O}$ be the vertices reachable from $D$, including $D$. If $K_1,\ldots,K_k$ are the components of $A\setminus D$, put $N_{\mathcal O}(z)=\{i:z\text{ has a neighbour in }K_i\cap S_{\mathcal O}\}$ for $z\in\{u,v\}$. Then $\mathcal H(A,D)$ is the hypergraph on $\{1,\ldots,k\}$ consisting of every $N_{\mathcal O}(u)$ and $N_{\mathcal O}(v)$.
codomain: Finite hypergraphs on the components of the complement of a marked three-vertex path
parameters: A marked induced path $D=u-c-v$ in a displayed ample family $A$.
normalization: The hyperedges range over all acyclic unique-sink orientations of $A$ and both endpoints of the marked path.
comments: A component two-colouring gives a nonpeelable ample expansion over $D$ exactly when it properly two-colours every hyperedge. Empty and singleton hyperedges therefore rule out negative labelings.
